name: Jeeter | 1g Liquid Diamond Disposable | Pina Colada
description:
Pina Colada is a hybrid strain with sweet, tropical flavors like pineapple and coconut on both the inhale and exhale. Smooth and balanced, it's an easy choice for any time of day. It’s five o'clock somewhere, so light up and relax with a Pina Colada in hand.

Ultra clean. Ultra potent. Ultra smooth. Built for our most refined extract, this AIO is made for Liquid Diamonds. With lighter viscosity and higher potency, the hardware is engineered to preserve clarity and deliver smooth, powerful hits without clogging or flooding.
